reference_sql:
WITH numbered AS (  -- one row per subscription_events row of 2025 as it arrived
  SELECT event_type,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY subscription_id, event_type, event_date, mrr_delta_local ORDER BY event_id) AS copy_no
  FROM subscription_events
  WHERE event_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND event_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
)
SELECT event_type, COUNT(*) AS rows_arrived, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE copy_no = 1) AS events
FROM numbered
GROUP BY event_type
alternatives:
WITH arrived AS (  -- one row per event type of 2025, as the rows arrived
  SELECT event_type, COUNT(*) AS rows_arrived
  FROM subscription_events
  WHERE event_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND event_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY event_type
),
events AS (  -- one row per event of 2025
  SELECT DISTINCT subscription_id, event_type, event_date, mrr_delta_local
  FROM subscription_events
  WHERE event_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND event_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
)
SELECT a.event_type, a.rows_arrived, COUNT(*) AS events
FROM arrived a
JOIN events e ON e.event_type = a.event_type
GROUP BY a.event_type, a.rows_arrived

SELECT t.event_type, COUNT(*) AS rows_arrived, SUM(CASE WHEN t.copy_no = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS events
FROM (
  -- one row per subscription_events row of 2025 as it arrived
  SELECT event_type,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY subscription_id, event_type, event_date, mrr_delta_local ORDER BY event_id) AS copy_no
  FROM subscription_events
  WHERE event_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND event_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
) AS t
GROUP BY t.event_type
